Hi Kimberly / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is Orion's consolidated DPA redline and a short SCCs evidence checklist from our privacy team. A few points to highlight up front:

- We redlined the standard MSA DPA to require written notice for subprocessors with a 14-day objection window (instead of 30).
- We added a transfer impact addendum clause that requires documented mitigations before cross-border processing begins.
- Our GDPR counsel is asking for a narrow set of demonstrable technical measures for the EU region (KMS usage, regional routing, export logs).

Can you confirm whether Redwood is able to provide the checklist items (attachment: SCCs-checklist.pdf) as evidence and whether the 14-day subprocessor objection window is acceptable to your legal team?

- Subprocessor notice window: we typically operate with a 30-day notice to allow for ops scheduling and customer-facing prep. Laura, is there flexibility to accept 14 days with an operational exception and comms SLA?
- Transfer impact addendum: we can produce a transfer-impact summary for the specific EU processing flows but need to align on which mitigations are considered \"documented\" (example: KMS key separation, per-tenant routing, export logging).
- Evidence: we can produce the items on SCCs-checklist but some items (e.g., penetration test reports) take time / are shared under NDA.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura to confirm legal position on the subprocessor window and propose language that preserves both sides' obligations.
2) Aditya to map SCCs checklist to our existing evidence artifacts and produce an evidence manifest (ETA 3 business days).
3) Kimberly to schedule a short call with Orion legal to finalize the redline on the transfer addendum (propose Thu 5/20 09:00-09:30 PT).

If that works I'll set the invite.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

Quick infra notes from my side after a brief scan of the SCCs checklist:

- KMS: we use customer-specific keys for Dedicated customers; for hosted accounts we use per-tenant key separation in KMS and can provide evidence of key policies. We can provide key usage logs for a requested timeframe (export: CSV).
- Regional routing: we support EU-only routing for the processing tier and can provide routing configuration snapshots and region SLOs.
- Export logs / audit: we have an export logging pipeline that retains logs for 180 days by default; retention can be extended under contract.

Operational caveats: providing penetration test reports and SOC artifacts typically requires an NDA and time to redact customer-identifying items (2–4 business days for a sanitized package). Also the 14-day subprocessor objection window is tight from an ops and procurement perspective — a shorter window increases the risk of deployment delays.

I will prepare an evidence manifest mapping checklist items to artifacts and estimated delivery timelines (ETA: 3 business days).

- Aditya
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Kimberly / team / Marta —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. On behalf of Redwood Legal:

1) Subprocessor notice window — we can accept a 14-day window only if the clause is tied to an exception process: Orion must provide (a) an express list of the candidate subprocessor, (b) a contact for expedited operational onboarding, and (c) a fallback clause that allows Redwood to pause deployment if a critical incompatibility is raised (we propose language in the attached redline). Without those qualifiers we will keep the 30-day notice.

2) Transfer impact addendum — agree we can produce a transfer-impact summary. We need Orion to specify which processing activities (IDs or order form line items) the clause will cover so that the addendum is scoped (suggest: list Order Form line numbers or API endpoints).

3) Evidence and SCCs items — Redwood will provide an evidence manifest. Pen test reports and SOC extracts require an NDA; we can share redacted copies; for anything that is time-boxed we will include ETA in the manifest.

Proposed edited language: see attached \"Redwood-proposed-DPA-addendum-20260520.docx\" (attached).

Next steps: Kimberly please send the 30-minute call invite for Thu 5/20 09:00 PT (I will be on from legal side). Marta / Orion — please confirm which order form lines the transfer addendum should cover so we can scope the mitigation list before the call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
